runnerNotes: Foundry invariant/fuzz runner used (256 fuzz runs on the slippage band). Medusa/Echidna not run: the target property is a deterministic round-trip accounting identity best expressed as a parameterized Foundry fuzz test against the project's real contracts; a stateful campaign adds no recall here. The four tests fully characterize the property (violation under any haircut, holds at par, dust-revert + rescue).
summary: The value-conservation invariant BREAKS under any haircutting re-injection strategy and HOLDS at par. The existing test suite is green only because its MockYieldStrategy ran at par (depositSlippageBps=0); turning the knob > 0 reveals a silent per-user principal shortfall.

fixed_200bps_case.note: Units are USDC (6 decimals). 8e6 = 8 USDC lost on a 400 USDC re-injection at 2% deposit slippage; loss scales linearly with slippage and pool size. totalParked driven to 0 despite the 8e6 shortfall.

creditedSum < parkedSum for all slippage in [1,500] bps; totalParked == 0; creditedSum == per-user haircut floors

results.asserts: migrateIn slice reverts 'StableStaker: nothing credited'; state rolled back (all 3 still parked); claimTimedOut returns dust user's full 1-unit principal
